How it works

Four steps. No fear of commitment.

01
Discovery call
Book a call. We talk through what's actually eating your time and where the trust gaps are.
02
Context handoff
You give me the business context once — the goal, the constraints, who else is involved. I don't come back with a string of clarifying questions.
03
Execution & systems build
I own inbox, calendar, vendor coordination, and the automation layer underneath it — Zapier, N8N, Power Automate, GHL — from day one.
04
Ongoing reporting, no re-explaining
Weekly cadence, Monday briefings, zero missed deadlines. If something's off-track, you hear it from me before you have to ask.
